prompt: My son doesn't want pet (mouse); he likes rabbits with tiny (foot).
explanation_ru: Существительные mouse и foot образуют множественное число не по правилам: mice и feet.

prompt: Thirty warm cakes sat on four clean (dish) with fresh (berry) on top.
explanation_ru: После шипящего -sh добавляется окончание -es (dishes), а конечная -y после согласной меняется на -ies (berries).

prompt: Ramon warns the book sellers because the police (want) to catch three (thief).
explanation_ru: Слово police всегда согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (want), а у thief во множественном числе -f меняется на -ves (thieves).

prompt: Twenty young (person) cleaned the windy beach so sea (fish) can swim safely.
explanation_ru: Обычное множественное число от person — people, а слово fish сохраняет одинаковую форму в единственном и множественном числе.

prompt: My grandmother split the warm biscuits into two (half) on clean metal (tray).
explanation_ru: У слова half во множественном числе -f меняется на -ves (halves), а в tray перед -y стоит гласная, поэтому просто добавляется -s (trays).

prompt: Should we bake sweet (potato) before our silent comedy starts, or do you prefer cheese (sandwich)?
explanation_ru: К слову potato и к существительным на -ch (sandwich) во множественном числе добавляется окончание -es: potatoes, sandwiches.

prompt: When dinner guests emptied the lemon bowl, the sisters wiped their (knife) and carried two (box) from Grandpa's garden.
explanation_ru: У слова knife окончание -fe меняется на -ves (knives), а после -x во множественном числе добавляется -es (boxes).

prompt: We haven't hung the paper flags yet because none of our roof (party) ever had enough (glass) for sixteen guests.
explanation_ru: В party буква -y после согласной меняется на -ies (parties), а после -ss добавляется окончание -es (glasses).

prompt: Even the (grown-up) at Orla's library talk couldn't believe how many teaspoons of salt sit inside four boxed soups.
explanation_ru: В сложном существительном grown-up без главного слова в начале окончание множественного числа -s ставится в конце: grown-ups.

prompt: While tidying the dusty archive (shelf) in Stirling, Flora found two old grocer (diary) listing rice and tea from 1940.
explanation_ru: В shelf конечная -f меняется на -ves (shelves), а в diary буква -y после согласной переходит в -ies (diaries).

prompt: "Look outside! Dad's beach shorts (need) another wash after a noisy chicken walked right across them on the porch."
explanation_ru: Существительное shorts обозначает парный предмет и всегда употребляется во множественном числе, поэтому глагол используется без -s (need).

prompt: Although my grandmother retired after thirty years of teaching, both of her (sister-in-law) still ask her for advice, and her reading glasses (be) always on the library table.
explanation_ru: В сложном существительном sister-in-law во множественное число ставится главное слово (sisters-in-law), а парное glasses всегда требует глагола во множественном числе (are).

prompt: Before opening the model railway hall in Augsburg, Helmut reminds visiting (child) not to touch the tracks and asks curious (passer-by) outside the window not to lean on it.
explanation_ru: Слово child имеет неправильную форму множественного числа children, а в составном passer-by окончание -s присоединяется к первой части (passers-by).

prompt: Over four hundred local (woman) and men carried wooden stools into the square in Braga after the morning news (be) broadcast on the town radio.
explanation_ru: Слово woman во множественном числе меняет корневую гласную (women), а неисчисляемое news в прошедшем времени согласуется с глаголом единственного числа (was).

prompt: I forgot my rain coat at home today. My brother's giant yellow jacket keeps me dry, though the sleeves cover my hands. My wet jeans (feel) freezing against my legs. Even my (tooth) are chattering in the school corridor.
explanation_ru: Слово jeans всегда множественного числа (глагол feel без -s), а tooth образует множественное число не по правилам — teeth.

prompt: Imogen loves checking the rocky pools near Plymouth. She counts thirty-eight small green crabs under the flat rocks. Small silver (fish) swim past the wet brown (leaf) in the water. Her old binoculars (help) her spot tiny sea animals from the shore.
explanation_ru: Fish не меняется во множественном числе, у leaf -f переходит в -ves (leaves), а binoculars всегда требует глагола во множественном числе (help).

prompt: Paloma and her aunt walked through the weekend market in Granada with a written list. They didn't find sweet figs, so they bought fresh (tomato) and linen napkins instead. Two friendly (man) at the kitchen stall showed them blue dishes and metal scissors. "These sharp scissors (cut) heavy string easily!" Paloma smiled.
explanation_ru: Tomato получает окончание -es (tomatoes), man образует неправильную форму men, а scissors всегда согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (cut).

prompt: Our amateur rugby team finished the rainy charity game in Belfast covered in mud. Three curious (sheep) watched us from the next field while we packed our bags. We counted eighteen wet socks, one flat ball, and no clean water bottles. "My muddy shorts (weigh) twice as much after winter (match) like this!" joked our captain.
explanation_ru: Слово sheep имеет одинаковую форму в единственном и множественном числе, shorts требует глагола во множественном числе (weigh), а match получает -es (matches).

prompt: "Can you show me how to make the screen text bigger?" asked my grandmother on our sunny porch in Coventry. I wrote four simple steps on a white card so she could save all her holiday (photo). She smiled because her other (grandchild) always type too fast for her to follow. "At last, my reading glasses really (help) when I open your messages!" she said.
explanation_ru: Сокращённое photo принимает только -s (photos), grandchild меняет вторую часть на -children (grandchildren), а glasses согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (help).

prompt: On a rainy morning in Sligo, my young nephew dropped his lunchbox right across the narrow country lane. Although two local (bus) had to brake sharply, nobody sounded a horn or complained. Instead, the friendly driver stepped out and helped several smiling (passer-by) rescue every rolling apple from the puddles. "Don't worry, my old trousers always (dry) quickly on the heater," the driver assured my uncle.
explanation_ru: После -s в bus добавляется -es (buses), в passer-by изменяется главное слово (passers-by), а trousers всегда употребляется с глаголом во множественном числе (dry).

prompt: Karin watched twelve international flights land on the arrivals board in Gothenburg before spotting her older brother near the exit. He was carrying two huge (bunch) of yellow flowers, even though he had promised not to bring gifts. "Both of our (brother-in-law) warned me to pack light, yet my luggage still (take) up half the trolley," he laughed. Karin hugged him and asked whether he had slept at all during the flight.
explanation_ru: Bunch принимает -es (bunches), в brother-in-law меняется главное слово (brothers-in-law), а неисчисляемое luggage требует глагола в единственном числе (takes).

prompt: Dear Sales Team, Six new standing desks reached our fourth-floor office in Hamburg with twenty extra bolts but only four wooden tops. Most of the office furniture still (sit) in pieces beside the lift because we cannot finish building it. Could you check whether your other delivery (company) mixed up our boxes with another order? Unless better news (reach) us before Friday, we will have to cancel the remaining (shelf) on our invoice. Kind regards, Dirk.
explanation_ru: Неисчисляемые furniture и news требуют глаголов в единственном числе (sits, reaches); company переходит в companies, а shelf — в shelves.

prompt: All forty ___ in the warm barn are safe from the freezing rain.
explanation_ru: Слово sheep не меняет форму во множественном числе. Типичная ошибка — добавлять окончание -s (sheeps).

prompt: Local sailors stay home when ___ bad along the stormy harbour road.
explanation_ru: Существительное news неисчисляемое: оно не используется с артиклем a и всегда требует глагола в единственном числе (is), а не are.

prompt: When the worried traveller reported his missing camera bag in Lucca, ___ already talking to his cousin near the ice-cream cart.
explanation_ru: Слово the police всегда согласуется с глаголом во множественном числе (were). Ошибочно ставить глагол в единственное число (was) по аналогии с русским «полиция».

prompt: We booked fifty folding chairs in Newport, yet ___ squeezing around two tiny tables for the anniversary lunch.
explanation_ru: People уже стоит во множественном числе и требует глагола are. Форма peoples в значении «люди» и глагол is — частые ошибки.

prompt: Although the Saskatoon print gallery displays lovely drawings, the lighting is so dim that ___ almost useless when visitors try to read the tiny wall cards.
explanation_ru: Существительное glasses (очки) всегда употребляется во множественном числе с глаголом are. Ошибки — ставить единственное число glass или глагол is/feels.

prompt: My two childs love eating warm fried rice and peanuts at the night market.
answer: My two children love eating warm fried rice and peanuts at the night market.
accepted_answers: My two children love eating warm fried rice and peanuts at the night market.
explanation_ru: Слово child образует множественное число не по правилам: children, а не childs.

prompt: Giorgos called to say your son's green swimming shorts is hanging safely on a fig tree in the garden.
answer: Giorgos called to say your son's green swimming shorts are hanging safely on a fig tree in the garden.
accepted_answers: Giorgos called to say your son's green swimming shorts are hanging safely on a fig tree in the garden.
explanation_ru: Слово shorts всегда стоит во множественном числе, поэтому вместо is нужен глагол are.

prompt: Thankfully, the news from the balcony in Trondheim is good because a teenager has spare drumsticks for Silje.
answer: Thankfully, the news from the balcony in Trondheim is good because a teenager has spare drumsticks for Silje.
accepted_answers: Thankfully, the news from the balcony in Trondheim is good because a teenager has spare drumsticks for Silje.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: существительное news неисчисляемое и правильно согласуется с глаголом единственного числа is.

prompt: Because thick autumn mist has stalled repairs on the Dartmouth drawbridge, the local police is directing fifty stuck delivery lorries down a narrow side road.
answer: Because thick autumn mist has stalled repairs on the Dartmouth drawbridge, the local police are directing fifty stuck delivery lorries down a narrow side road.
accepted_answers: Because thick autumn mist has stalled repairs on the Dartmouth drawbridge, the local police are directing fifty stuck delivery lorries down a narrow side road.
explanation_ru: Существительное the police всегда требует глагола во множественном числе: нужно are directing вместо is directing.

prompt: Mark's twins tried on warm winter trousers at the shop in Winnipeg, and the trousers fit well. Which sentence is correct?
options: These warm winter trousers is very comfortable for the twins.
This warm winter trousers are very comfortable for the twins.
These warm winter trousers are very comfortable for the twins.
A warm winter trousers are very comfortable for the twins.
explanation_ru: Существительное trousers всегда стоит во множественном числе, поэтому с ним используются указательное местоимение these и глагол are (без артикля a).

prompt: Shirley is writing the monthly school bulletin in Gisborne to announce that grandparents gave ninety atlases and five green floor cushions to the pupils. Which sentence is completely correct?
options: The library news are wonderful because local grandparents donated ninety atlas and five cushions for the children.
The library news is wonderful because local grandparents donated ninety atlases and five cushions for the children.
A library news is wonderful because local grandparents donated ninety atlases and five cushions for the childs.
The library news is wonderful because local grandparents donated ninety atlas and five cushions for the childrens.
explanation_ru: Верно только второе предложение: news согласуется с единственным числом (is, без a), atlas во множественном числе — atlases, а child — children.

prompt: A relieved man thanked Isabel after she returned his watch and three folded banknotes at Palma airport. → Two relieved …
answer: Two relieved men thanked Isabel after she returned their watches and three folded banknotes at Palma airport.
accepted_answers: Two relieved men thanked Isabel after she returned their watches and three folded banknotes at Palma airport.
explanation_ru: Во множественном числе man меняется на men, притяжательное местоимение his — на their, а к watch добавляется окончание -es (watches).

prompt: An officer has located ten stolen deckchairs on Eastbourne beach and is returning them before Sunday's band plays. → The police …
answer: The police have located ten stolen deckchairs on Eastbourne beach and are returning them before Sunday's band plays.
accepted_answers: The police have located ten stolen deckchairs on Eastbourne beach and are returning them before Sunday's band plays.
explanation_ru: С подлежащим the police оба сказуемых переходят во множественное число: have located и are returning.
